messages:
Maya: Spontaneous LAN night tomorrow? I can lug in a tiny arcade cabinet (CRT + Raspberry Pi) if we wanna do some retro slots. Mezzanine 7pm? :joystick:

Jon: Very tempted. I can bring an extra Ethernet switch and a couple of power strips (surge-protected). Need more controllers tho.

Sam: Count me in for couch co-op. Bringing my Steam library (big indie pile). Also up for Portal 2 speedrun attempts if people are into that. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya: I have two extra Xbox controllers and a couple of USB adapters. Can bring snacks too (vegan options). What games are we prioritizing?

Maya: Nice, thanks Priya. Proposal: 1) Retro cabinet (arcade classics) 2) Switch party (Smash/Mario Kart) 3) PC indie rotation + Portal 2 speedruns 4) Chill co-op backlog. Rotate every ~90 mins. Sound good?

Jon: Works for me. Quick note: bring ethernet cables (cat6), label them. Last time it was chaos.

Sam: Agreed. I'll make a tiny sticky-note kit: labels + spare batteries. Also bringing a Switch dock and HDMI switch in case the cabinet needs HDMI passthrough.

Priya: RSVP poll (quick): who needs controller loaners?

Maya: Maya: 1 controller
Jon: 0
Sam: 2 controllers
Priya: 0 (bringing extras)

OpsBot: Calendar: Mezzanine reserved 19:00-23:30 tomorrow by Maya. Reminder will post 2 hours before.

Maya: Logistics checklist (copy/pasteable):
```
- Ethernet switch + cables (labelled)
- Power strips (surge)
- Controllers + adapters
- CRT cabinet + HDMI adapter
- Spare batteries & chargers
- Snacks (label vegan/gluten)
- Sticky-label kit
- Basic first-aid kit
```

Sam: Also can anyone bring a spare router just in case NAT gets weird? I can set up a small LAN-only network.

Jon: I'll toss in my spare router. Pro tip: set static IPs for the consoles to avoid DHCP race.

Priya: Sounding like a plan. See you all ~7pm. If something changes ping here. :party_parrot:
